content.rendered:
The Archer Glen school office will be closed beginning on Friday, June 23rd at 1:00 pm.

The front office will reopen on Friday, August 18th. Office hours will be 7:30 am to 3:30 pm.

If you need assistance you can contact the Sherwood School District office at 503-825-5000, Monday through Thursday throughout the summer months.
